## 基本用法

我們展示了 “vicuna-13b” 模型，您可以直接在以下位置使用： <https://replicate.com/replicate/vicuna-13b>

```
from llama_index.llms.replicate import Replicate


llm = Replicate(
    model="replicate/vicuna-13b:6282abe6a492de4145d7bb601023762212f9ddbbe78278bd6771c8b3b2f2a13b"
)
```

#### 使用 prompt 呼叫 `complete`

```
resp = llm.complete("Who is Paul Graham?")
```

```
print(resp)
```

#### 使用訊息列表呼叫 `chat`

```
from llama_index.core.llms import ChatMessage


messages = [
    ChatMessage(
        role="system", content="You are a pirate with a colorful personality"
    ),
    ChatMessage(role="user", content="What is your name"),
]
resp = llm.chat(messages)
```

```
print(resp)
```

### Streaming

使用 `stream_complete` endpoint

```
response = llm.stream_complete("Who is Paul Graham?")
```

```
for r in response:
    print(r.delta, end="")
```


## 設定模型

```
from llama_index.llms.replicate import Replicate


llm = Replicate(
    model="replicate/vicuna-13b:6282abe6a492de4145d7bb601023762212f9ddbbe78278bd6771c8b3b2f2a13b",
    temperature=0.9,
    max_tokens=32,
)
```
